pills.loan: Bank loan (30% of cost after subsidy)

overview.chart40Axis: Y-axis: cumulative net cash position (₹ crore). Gold line; dashed vertical: Year 11 (loan paid).
overview.wCash: You need ~{{amountL}} in cash (~{{amount}}) — equity plus 6% operating reserve. Subsidy typically disburses over months; plan working capital.
overview.wPpa: PPA tariff is locked only for the years stated in your DISCOM / PPA — model assumes mid-tariff; renegotiation risk after lock.
overview.wPpaLock: Many feed-in / banking arrangements assume about {{years}} years of tariff visibility — confirm your DISCOM order; renegotiation risk rises after the lock.
overview.wTx: DISCOM grid approval typically 8–14 weeks — treat as critical path from Day 1.
overview.wDust: Soiling can cost 8–12% energy if under-cleaned — budget robots or manual washing.
overview.wDustRj: Rajasthan: budget robot or frequent manual cleaning — dust losses often 8–12% without it.

costs.landFree: ₹0 — psychological anchor; you already own the land.
costs.subsidyDelay: Subsidy disbursement in practice is often 4–9 months after milestones — do not model 30–60 days.
costs.reserve: Keep the 6% operating reserve aside for commissioning, LDC charges, and initial O&M spikes.
costs.gst: GST on solar plant typically ~5% (consult your CA).
costs.ad: Accelerated depreciation may apply for business structures — not personal farming income in all cases.
costs.rec: RECs / other incentives depend on scheme registration and DISCOM.
costs.nabard: NABARD / cooperative refinancing may offer competitive rates for eligible groups.

model.note: After Year 10, EMI ends. Monthly income rises sharply — this is your “golden phase”; verify O&M and tariff annually.

risks.title: Risk / Impact / Mitigation
risks.r1i: 6–18 month revenue push-out; ₹10L–2Cr+ if HT extension needed
risks.r1m: Apply at DISCOM on Day 1; weekly follow-up; parallel-track transformer / bay booking.
risks.r2i: Subsidy or component blocked until next tranche — ₹5–20L+ working capital gap
risks.r2m: Register early on nodal portal; confirm district quota; keep alternate DISCOM route.
risks.r3i: COD slip → revenue delay; carrying cost on debt
risks.r3m: Issue PO at sanction; dual-source OEMs; align EPC construction window.
risks.r4i: Cash flow hole vs model that assumes quick subsidy
risks.r4m: Bank tranches for COD; do not book subsidy before nodal confirmation in account.
risks.r5m: Robot or AMC contract; wash after dust storms; track PR monthly.
risks.r6i: 5–12% seasonal PR drop; higher in heavy-rain states (e.g. MH, KA)
risks.r6m: Conservative PR in model; add 1–2% O&M buffer for cleaning spikes.
risks.r7i: 10–25% revenue variance if tariff order changes
risks.r7m: Legal review of PPA; model −₹0.20/unit sensitivity; keep LDC clauses.
risks.r8m: Milestone payments; performance bank guarantee; ALMM-only BOM in contract.

agri.cropsDef: Seasonal vegetables, pulses, oilseeds — match local mandi demand.
agri.incomeNote: ₹20k–80k / acre / year highly variable — depends on crop, water, and market.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lastUpdated: Draft — May 2026. Review with counsel before publication.
privacy.intro: This policy describes how SolarBharat handles information when you use the website. We aim to collect only what we need to run the product.
privacy.s1p: We may collect information you submit (e.g. calculator inputs, forms for contractors, forum posts, alert signups, review intake) and technical data such as browser type, approximate location from IP, and analytics events if you enable optional analytics.
privacy.s2p: We use data to operate features (reports, directories, community), improve the service, fix bugs, and measure aggregate usage. We do not sell personal data.
privacy.s3p: When configured, data may be stored in Supabase (PostgreSQL) and sent through email or analytics providers you enable (e.g. PostHog). Subprocessors depend on your deployment configuration.
privacy.s4p: We may use cookies or local storage for sessions, preferences, and optional analytics. You can control cookies in your browser; blocking some cookies may limit functionality.
privacy.s5p: We retain information as needed to operate the service and meet legal obligations. Forum or intake records may be kept for moderation and safety.
privacy.s6p: Where applicable law grants rights (access, correction, deletion), contact us using the details on the Contact page. We may need to verify requests.
privacy.notice: Align this policy with your actual hosting stack and counsel before going live.
